title: Ciudad / Selva
theme: the jungle growing through the city
techniques: double exposure: a city lattice (+9.5 deg) and a canopy lattice (-26 deg) printed over each other on one sheet
one faceless hybrid silhouette (jaguar head + stepped tower + piers) used as the phase mask where the two images meet
the print inverts inside the mask: warm black field, the same city grid in bone (rotated a further 4 deg, narrower), the same foliage in solid green
ink density carries the double exposure; no opacity, no blend modes
deliberate misregistration: the pink city plate's offset varies across the sheet, every leaf fill sits (-5,+4) off its keyline, the mask's pink ghost is +13/+10
hand-drawn wobble generated as per-vertex jitter on the street and vine paths
four flat inks only; fractal-noise grain as the final layer (opacity 0.13)
statement: The jungle growing through the city, printed as two images pulled out of register. A city of bars and mullions and a canopy of leaves cross until they beat into an interference pattern; a single faceless mass - jaguar head, stepped tower, piers - lies across the middle as the place where the plates change phase, its belly built out of the city in negative and green growing through its back.
composition: All-over interference pattern with no horizon and no subject band; a full-bleed lattice of two tilted images, interrupted once by a large silhouette that acts as a mask and a phase boundary rather than as a character in front of wallpaper.
